name: Coinbase Agentic Wallet Skills
summary: Pre-built agent skills for wallet operations (authenticate, fund, send USDC, trade, pay for x402 services) via Coinbase's awal CLI.

agent_access.notes: Install with `npx skills add coinbase/agentic-wallet-skills` (not run). Former CDP /agentic-wallet docs returned 404 on 2026-11-14. Real-money wallet/x402 side effects if used. Not Coinbase Wallet MCP.

description: MIT skill pack (repo coinbase/agentic-wallet-skills; not archived; last pushed 2026-08-04; LICENSE.md is MIT, Copyright 2026 Coinbase; a root file named LICENSE returns 404). Documented install is `npx skills add coinbase/agentic-wallet-skills` (not executed). Skills cover wallet operations used with the awal CLI (authenticate, fund, send USDC, trade, pay for x402 services). Real-money side effects if those skills are run; no wallet, key or spend was used here. As of 2026-11-14 the former docs URL https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/agentic-wallet/cli/skills/overview and the welcome URL https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/agentic-wallet/welcome return HTTP 404 and are absent from the current CDP llms.txt. This pack is not Coinbase Wallet MCP (`npx skills add coinbase/agents --skill wallet-mcp`). Official deprecation was not found; status remains active.
